226	- Layer 3 消除 semantic violations（DR），是 OntoCoDec 独有的贡献
227	- 两层组合（S1 单通道或 S2 两通道）实现从格式到语义的完整约束覆盖

- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** ASAp 解决的是 grammar-constrained decoding 的理论正确性问题。OntoCoDec 的 logits masking 也面临类似的分布扭曲风险，但实验证明在 IE 任务上 F1 无损，说明 IE 场景中合法约束的 masking 影响有限。
- **BibTeX key:** `park2024grammar`
- **ArXiv:** 2405.21047

## 2. Vocabulary/Type-Constrained Generation

### GENRE | ICLR 2021
- **Title:** Autoregressive Entity Retrieval
- **Authors:** De Cao, Izacard, Riedel & Petroni
- **核心方法:** 首个用自回归生成方式检索实体的系统，基于 fine-tuned BART 逐 token 生成实体名，用 prefix trie 约束 beam search 只允许生成合法实体标识符，在 20+ entity disambiguation/linking 基准上达到 SOTA。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** GENRE 的 trie-based constrained beam search 是 vocabulary-constrained generation 的经典范式。OntoCoDec 的 Semantic 层借鉴类似思路（限制输出到合法类型/实体），但不需要构建 trie，而是通过 logits masking 直接在 token 级别实施 domain/range 约束。
- **BibTeX key:** `decao2021genre`
- **ArXiv:** 2010.00904

### GenIE | NAACL 2022
- **Title:** GenIE: Generative Information Extraction
- **Authors:** Josifoski, De Cao, Peyrard, Petroni & West
- **核心方法:** 自回归 seq2seq 模型生成 (subject, relation, object) 三元组，结合 trie-based lexical constraints（强制输出合法实体/关系标识符）和 state-based constraints（强制合法三元组结构），实现端到端抽取。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** GenIE 是将 vocabulary constraint 应用于 IE 的先驱，但需要 fine-tuning 专用模型。OntoCoDec 的关键优势是 training-free——直接在通用 LLM 上通过解码时约束实现，无需额外训练。
- **BibTeX key:** `josifoski2022genie`
- **ArXiv:** 2112.08340

### NeuroLogic Decoding | NAACL 2021
- **Title:** NeuroLogic Decoding: (Un)supervised Neural Text Generation with Predicate Logic Constraints
- **Authors:** Lu, West, Zellers, Le Bras, Bhagavatula & Choi
- **核心方法:** 将词汇约束表达为谓词逻辑公式（合取/析取 of must-include/must-exclude tokens），在每步通过 pruning 和 re-ranking beams 执行约束，渐近复杂度等同标准 beam search。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** NeuroLogic 处理的是 lexical inclusion/exclusion 约束（"生成必须包含词 X"），而 OntoCoDec 的 Semantic 层处理的是 relational/type 约束（"关系 R 的 head 必须是类型 T"）。约束语义层次不同。
- **BibTeX key:** `lu2021neurologic`
- **ArXiv:** 2010.12884

### Grammar-Constrained Decoding for Structured NLP | EMNLP 2023
- **Title:** Grammar-Constrained Decoding for Structured NLP Tasks without Finetuning
- **Authors:** Geng, Josifoski, Peyrard & West
- **核心方法:** 提出 grammar-constrained decoding（GCD）统一框架：每步将违反形式文法的 token logits 设为负无穷，保证结构合法输出，无需 fine-tuning。引入 input-dependent grammars 增加灵活性。在 IE、entity disambiguation、constituency parsing 上验证。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** 这是最直接的前驱工作——同样对 IE 任务使用 logits masking。但 Geng et al. 的约束限于语法层面（输出格式合法），OntoCoDec 在此基础上增加了语义层约束（domain/range 合法），是从格式正确到语义正确的扩展。
- **BibTeX key:** `geng2023gcd`
- **ArXiv:** 2305.13971

## 3. Structural Constraints for Information Extraction

### UIE | ACL 2022
- **Title:** Unified Structure Generation for Universal Information Extraction
- **Authors:** Lu, Liu, Dai et al.
- **核心方法:** 定义 Structured Extraction Language（SEL）统一编码不同 IE 输出结构（entity, relation, event, sentiment），配合 schema-based prompt（Structural Schema Instructor）和大规模预训练 text-to-structure 模型，在 4 个 IE 任务 13 个数据集上达到 SOTA。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** UIE 通过训练让模型"学会"输出合法结构，但无法保证推理时不违反 schema 约束。OntoCoDec 是 decoding-time enforcement，提供硬性保证——违反 domain/range 的输出不可能被生成。
- **BibTeX key:** `lu2022uie`
- **ArXiv:** 2203.12277

### GoLLIE | ICLR 2024
- **Title:** Annotation Guidelines improve Zero-Shot Information-Extraction
- **Authors:** Sainz, Garcia-Ferrero, Agerri et al.
- **核心方法:** 将 annotation guidelines 表达为 Python class 定义（dataclass），fine-tune Code-LLaMA 生成 Python 代码形式的结构化输出，通过 code-based schema 表达实现强零样本泛化到未见 IE schema。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** GoLLIE 用 Python 类型系统隐式表达类型约束，但执行仍依赖模型训练。OntoCoDec 在解码时显式执行本体约束，两者互补——GoLLIE 的 code-based schema 可与 OntoCoDec 的 decoding-time enforcement 结合。
- **BibTeX key:** `sainz2024gollie`
- **ArXiv:** 2310.03668

### CodeIE | ACL 2023
- **Title:** Large Code Generation Models are Better Few-Shot Information Extractors
- **Authors:** Li, Sun, Tang et al.
- **核心方法:** 将 IE 结构化输出重构为代码生成任务，用 code-LLM（Codex）+ code-style prompts 执行 NER 和 RE，代码形式天然捕获 IE 输出的结构性。在 few-shot 设置下一致优于 fine-tuned IE 模型和 NL-LLM prompting。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** CodeIE 通过代码形式化提高结构一致性，但仍是 soft constraint（模型可能生成非法代码）。OntoCoDec 的 Grammar+Semantic 层提供 hard constraint——输出格式和语义类型均被强制保证。
- **BibTeX key:** `li2023codeie`
- **ArXiv:** 2305.05711

### InstructUIE | arXiv 2023
- **Title:** Multi-task Instruction Tuning for Unified Information Extraction
- **Authors:** Wang, Zhou, Zu et al.
- **核心方法:** 构建 IE INSTRUCTIONS 基准（32 个 IE 数据集统一为 text-to-text 格式 + 专家指令），fine-tune Flan-T5 实现单模型处理 NER/RE/EE。指令微调的小模型大幅超越 GPT-3.5。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** InstructUIE 靠 instruction tuning 提高 IE 输出质量，但无结构保证。OntoCoDec 与 InstructUIE 正交——可在 instruction-tuned 模型上叠加 decoding-time 约束进一步消除违规。
- **BibTeX key:** `wang2023instructuie`
- **ArXiv:** 2304.08085

### ADELIE | EMNLP 2024
- **Title:** Aligning Large Language Models on Information Extraction
- **Authors:** Qi, Peng, Wang et al. (THU-KEG)
- **核心方法:** 构建 IEInstruct 高质量对齐语料，用 SFT + DPO 训练 LLM 进行 IE，覆盖 closed IE、open IE、on-demand IE。ADELIE 在开源模型中达到 SOTA，同时保持通用 LLM 能力。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** ADELIE 代表 training-time alignment 路线，通过 preference optimization 让模型偏好合法输出。OntoCoDec 是 decoding-time enforcement 路线，提供更强保证且 training-free。两者可叠加使用。
- **BibTeX key:** `qi2024adelie`
- **ArXiv:** 2405.05008

- **Title:** ODKE+: Ontology-Guided Open-Domain Knowledge Extraction with LLMs
- **Authors:** Khorshidi, Nikfarjam, Shankar et al. (Apple)
- **核心方法:** 动态生成针对每种实体类型的 ontology snippets（含 domain/range 约束），用于对齐 LLM 抽取结果与 schema 约束。处理 9M+ Wikipedia 页面，19M facts，98.8% precision across 195 predicates。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** ODKE+ 在 prompt 层面注入 ontology 约束，属于 soft guidance。OntoCoDec 在 decoding 层面强制执行 domain/range 约束，属于 hard enforcement。ODKE+ 无法保证 0% violation rate，OntoCoDec 可以。
- **BibTeX key:** `khorshidi2025odke`
- **ArXiv:** 2509.04696

### Open IE with Entity Focused Constraints | Findings of EACL 2023
- **Title:** Open Information Extraction with Entity Focused Constraints
- **Authors:** Upadhyay, Balalau & Manolescu
- **核心方法:** 将 entity-type 知识作为约束注入 Open IE，通过 constrained inference（解码时）和 constraint-aware training 两种机制实现，在 CaRB 上 F1 提升 29.17%。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** 与 OntoCoDec 最相近的工作之一——同样在解码时利用 entity type 约束。但该方法针对 Open IE 的通用类型约束，OntoCoDec 针对 closed IE 的 ontology-specific domain/range 约束，粒度更细。
- **BibTeX key:** `upadhyay2023openie`

- **Title:** EnriCo: Enriched Representation and Globally Constrained Inference for Entity and Relation Extraction
- **Authors:** Zaratiana, Tomeh, Dauxais, Holat & Charnois
- **核心方法:** Attention-based enriched representations for joint entity and relation extraction，结合一套 constrained decoding 算法在推理时强制执行任务特定的结构约束（如 entity type compatibility for relations）。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** EnriCo 在传统 joint extraction 模型上加 constrained decoding，OntoCoDec 在 LLM 上做。EnriCo 的约束是模型特定的，OntoCoDec 的约束来自外部 ontology，更通用、可复用。
- **BibTeX key:** `zaratiana2024enrico`
- **ArXiv:** 2404.12493

- **Title:** Can LLMs be Knowledge Graph Curators for Validating Triple Insertions?
- **Authors:** Regino & dos Reis
- **核心方法:** 用 prompt-based 多阶段验证管线引导 LLM 评估 RDF triple 插入的 domain/range 一致性和语义连贯性。

- **BibTeX key:** `regino2025kgcurator`

## 5. Constrained Decoding Quality Concerns

### Let Me Speak Freely? | EMNLP 2024
- **Title:** Let Me Speak Freely? A Study on the Impact of Format Restrictions on Performance of Large Language Models
- **Authors:** Tam, Wu, Tsai, Lin, Lee & Chen
- **核心方法:** 系统研究结构化格式约束（JSON, XML, YAML）对 LLM 推理能力的影响。发现刚性格式约束损害推理密集型任务（数学、多跳 QA）但有利于分类任务（slot-filling、intent detection）。约束越严格，性能退化越大。
- **与 OntoCoDec 的关系:** 这是 OntoCoDec 需要直接回应的 concern。OntoCoDec 在 SciERC 上证明 F1 无损（甚至略有提升），说明在 IE 任务场景下——属于该论文发现的"分类任务"范畴——约束解码不仅不损害质量，反而可能有益。

- **ArXiv:** 2408.02442

### CRANE | ICML 2025
- **Title:** CRANE: Reasoning with Constrained LLM Generation
- **Authors:** Banerjee, Suresh, Ugare, Misailovic & Singh
- **核心方法:** 从理论角度解释为什么将 LLM 输出约束到 restrictive grammars（只允许语法合法的最终答案）会降低推理能力。提出 alternating strategy：在 unconstrained generation（推理/CoT）和 constrained generation（结构化输出）之间交替，在 GSM-symbolic 和 FOLIO 上提升最多 10 个百分点。

- **BibTeX key:** `schall2025hiddencost`

## 6. OntoCoDec 在 Landscape 中的定位

### 核心差异化

OntoCoDec 在约束解码 landscape 中占据独特位置，体现为三个维度的创新：

**1. 约束层次：从格式到语义**
- 现有 grammar-constrained decoding（XGrammar, Outlines, LMQL）保证**格式正确性**（valid JSON, enum values）
- 现有 vocabulary-constrained generation（GENRE, NeuroLogic）保证**词汇合法性**（输出在预定义词表中）
- OntoCoDec 增加**语义正确性**层（domain/range 约束），将约束从 syntactic 扩展到 semantic

**2. 执行时机：从 post-hoc 到 preventive**
- 传统 ontology validation 方法（ODKE+, KG validation）是 post-hoc：先生成再验证
- 训练方法（UIE, GoLLIE, ADELIE）是 soft constraint：通过训练引导模型偏好合法输出，但无保证
- OntoCoDec 是 decoding-time enforcement：不合法的输出不可能被生成，无需验证-纠错循环

**3. 质量保持：约束无损**
- 约束解码质量 concern（Let Me Speak Freely, CRANE, Structure Snowballing）指出约束常损害推理
- OntoCoDec 在 SciERC 上 DR violation 15.37%→0.93%（↓94%）且 F1 无损，反驳"约束必损质量"的 narrative
- OntoCoDec S2 策略（两通道分离）符合 CRANE 理论推荐的 alternating approach

### 技术栈定位

```
Layer 3 (OntoCoDec Semantic): domain/range logits masking ← 本文贡献
Layer 2 (OntoCoDec Grammar):  JSON schema + enum constraints ← 基于 XGrammar
Layer 1 (LLM):                base language model generation
```

- Layer 2 消除 format violations（RV/ET），与 Outlines/LMQL/SGLang 同层
- Layer 3 消除 semantic violations（DR），是 OntoCoDec 独有的贡献
- 两层组合（S1 单通道或 S2 两通道）实现从格式到语义的完整约束覆盖

### 与各 paradigm 的关系总结

| Paradigm | 代表工作 | OntoCoDec 关系 |
|----------|----------|---------------|
| Grammar-constrained decoding | XGrammar, Outlines, LMQL | OntoCoDec Grammar 层基于此；Semantic 层是超越 |
| Vocabulary/type-constrained generation | GENRE, GenIE, GCD | OntoCoDec 借鉴 logits masking 技术，但约束来自 IE ontology 而非固定词表 |
| Structural constraint for IE | UIE, GoLLIE, CodeIE | 这些方法靠 training/prompting，OntoCoDec 是 decoding-time enforcement，两者互补 |
| Ontology validation | ODKE+, EnriCo | Post-hoc validation vs. preventive enforcement 的本质区别 |
| Constrained decoding quality | Let Me Speak Freely, CRANE | OntoCoDec F1 无损实验直接回应此 concern，S2 策略符合 CRANE 理论 |

\section{Related Work}
\label{sec:related_work}

% ===========================================================================
% Paradigm 1: Grammar-Constrained Decoding
% ===========================================================================
\paragraph{Grammar-Constrained Decoding.}
Recent work has established efficient algorithms for restricting LLM outputs to conform to context-free grammars, ensuring structural validity of generated text.
%
XGrammar~\cite{dong2025xgrammar} partitions the vocabulary into context-independent and context-dependent tokens, achieving 100$\times$ speedup over prior CFG-constrained decoding via persistent pushdown automata.
%
Outlines~\cite{willard2023outlines} reformulates constrained generation as finite-state machine transitions with offline vocabulary indexing, while LMQL~\cite{beurer-kellner2023lmql} introduces a declarative query language that compiles type, length, and regex constraints into token-level masks.
%
A parallel line addresses the \emph{distribution distortion} introduced by naive token masking: DOMINO~\cite{beurer-kellner2024domino} minimizes distributional divergence during CFG enforcement, and ASAp~\cite{park2024grammar} provides an unbiased sampling algorithm that preserves the original LM distribution under grammar constraints.
%
\textbf{Distinction:} OntoCoDec's grammar layer builds on XGrammar for structural (JSON schema + enum) constraints, but these methods operate exclusively at the syntactic level---they ensure format validity but cannot enforce cross-field semantic constraints such as ontology domain/range rules.

% TODO: Expand with 2-3 sentences on how grammar-constrained decoding has become
% the de facto standard for structured output, and why the syntactic-only limitation
% motivates our semantic extension.

% ===========================================================================
% Paradigm 2: Vocabulary/Type-Constrained Generation
% ===========================================================================
\paragraph{Vocabulary and Type-Constrained Generation.}
A related family of methods constrains generation at the vocabulary level, restricting output tokens to a predefined set of valid identifiers rather than enforcing grammatical structure.
%
GENRE~\cite{decao2021genre} pioneers trie-based constrained beam search for autoregressive entity retrieval, limiting each decoding step to tokens consistent with valid entity names.
%
GenIE~\cite{josifoski2022genie} extends this to end-to-end IE with state-based constraints that enforce valid triple structures, though it requires task-specific fine-tuning.
%
GCD~\cite{geng2023gcd} provides a unified grammar-constrained decoding framework for structured NLP tasks including IE, introducing input-dependent grammars for greater flexibility.
%
NeuroLogic Decoding~\cite{lu2021neurologic} expresses lexical inclusion/exclusion constraints as predicate logic formulas enforced during beam search.
%
\textbf{Distinction:} These approaches constrain \emph{which tokens} can appear (vocabulary membership) but not \emph{which type combinations} are valid for a given relation. OntoCoDec's semantic layer enforces relational constraints---e.g., that the head entity of relation $R$ must belong to type set $\mathcal{D}(R)$---which cannot be expressed as static vocabulary restrictions.

% TODO: Add 1-2 sentences positioning GCD as the closest precursor (same logits-masking
% mechanism for IE) and clarifying that OntoCoDec extends from syntactic to semantic constraints.

% ===========================================================================
% Paradigm 3: Structural Constraints for IE
% ===========================================================================
\paragraph{Structural Constraints via Training and Prompting.}
An orthogonal approach encodes IE output structure through model training or prompt design rather than decoding-time enforcement.
%
UIE~\cite{lu2022uie} defines a Structured Extraction Language and trains a unified text-to-structure model across 13 IE datasets, relying on large-scale pre-training to produce schema-compliant outputs.
%
GoLLIE~\cite{sainz2024gollie} expresses annotation guidelines as Python dataclass definitions, fine-tuning Code-LLaMA to generate typed code, achieving strong zero-shot transfer to unseen IE schemas.
%
CodeIE~\cite{li2023codeie} reformulates IE as code generation, leveraging the implicit type structure of programming languages.
%
ADELIE~\cite{qi2024adelie} uses SFT and DPO to align LLMs on IE tasks, achieving SOTA among open-source models while preserving general capabilities.
%
\textbf{Distinction:} Training-based methods provide \emph{soft} structural guidance---the model learns to prefer valid outputs but offers no compliance guarantee at inference time. OntoCoDec provides \emph{hard} decoding-time enforcement that is training-free and composable with any of these approaches.

% TODO: Expand with discussion of how training-based and decoding-time approaches
% are complementary (e.g., GoLLIE + OntoCoDec), not competing.

% ===========================================================================
% Paradigm 4: Type-Checking / Ontology Validation
% ===========================================================================
\paragraph{Post-hoc Ontology Validation.}
Rather than constraining generation, several methods validate LLM outputs against ontological rules after generation.
%
ODKE+~\cite{khorshidi2025odke} dynamically generates ontology snippets containing domain/range constraints as prompt context, achieving 98.8\% precision across 195 predicates at web scale---but constraint adherence relies on prompt-level guidance, not enforcement.
%
\citet{upadhyay2023openie} inject entity-type knowledge as constraints into Open IE via both constrained inference and constraint-aware training, improving F1 by 29\% on CaRB.
%
\citet{regino2025kgcurator} propose a multi-stage LLM pipeline for validating RDF triple insertions against domain/range constraints, representing the post-hoc validation paradigm.
%
EnriCo~\cite{zaratiana2024enrico} applies constrained decoding to joint entity-relation extraction models to enforce type compatibility, but with model-specific (non-ontology-driven) constraints.
%
\textbf{Distinction:} Post-hoc validation detects violations after generation, requiring rejection or correction cycles that waste compute (14--15\% rejection rate in our setting). OntoCoDec \emph{prevents} violations during decoding, redirecting probability mass to valid alternatives rather than discarding invalid outputs.

% TODO: Add quantitative comparison of compute cost: post-hoc rejection vs.
% preventive enforcement (marginal overhead of logits masking vs. wasted tokens).

% ===========================================================================
% Paradigm 5: Constrained Decoding Quality Concerns
% ===========================================================================
\paragraph{Quality Impact of Constrained Decoding.}

已写入 `artifacts/section6_relwork_outline.tex` 并注册。结构概要：

| Paragraph | Topic Sentence 定位 | Key Citations | Differentiation |
|-----------|-------------------|---------------|-----------------|
| **Grammar-Constrained Decoding** | CFG 约束保证结构合法性 | XGrammar, Outlines, LMQL, DOMINO, ASAp | OntoCoDec grammar 层基于此，但这些方法止于语法层，无法处理 domain/range |
| **Vocabulary/Type-Constrained** | 词汇级限制输出到合法标识符 | GENRE, GenIE, GCD, NeuroLogic | 限制"哪些 token"但不限制"哪些类型组合"对特定 relation 合法 |
| **Structural Constraints (Training)** | 通过训练/prompt 编码 IE 结构 | UIE, GoLLIE, CodeIE, ADELIE | Soft guidance vs. OntoCoDec 的 hard enforcement，两者互补 |
| **Post-hoc Ontology Validation** | 生成后验证 ontology 合规 | ODKE+, Upadhyay'23, Regino'25, EnriCo | Post-hoc 浪费 14-15% 计算（reject），OntoCoDec 在解码时 prevent |
| **Quality Concerns** | 约束解码降低推理质量的担忧 | Let Me Speak Freely, CRANE (ICML'25), Hidden Cost, Snowballing | OntoCoDec F1 无损实证回应；IE 属 extraction 非 reasoning，影响有限 |
| **Our Approach** | 三句话定位 OntoCoDec 独特性 | — | 首个 ontology→decoding semantic constraint 编译；stateful cross-field enforcement；training-free + zero cost |
